MORE:
PFL Infotech Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 12/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve Pursuant to Regulation 29(1)(a) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform you that a meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled to be held on Thursday, 12th November, 2026, inter alia, to consider and approve the following matters:

1. To consider and approve the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September, 2026, along with the Limited Review Report thereon issued by the Statutory Auditors of the Company.

2. To consider any other matter with the permission of the Chair.
